scope: Metadados; nao e backup do banco

indexes.indexdef: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX people_pkey ON public.people USING btree (id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX inspection_checklist_items_pkey ON public.inspection_checklist_items USING btree (id)
CREATE INDEX inspection_checklist_items_inspection_id_idx ON public.inspection_checklist_items USING btree (inspection_id)
CREATE INDEX inspection_checklist_items_completed_idx ON public.inspection_checklist_items USING btree (inspection_id, completed)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX default_checklist_items_pkey ON public.default_checklist_items USING btree (id)
CREATE INDEX default_checklist_items_active_order_idx ON public.default_checklist_items USING btree (active, order_index, created_at)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX inspections_pkey ON public.inspections USING btree (id)
CREATE INDEX inspections_assigned_to_scheduled_start_idx ON public.inspections USING btree (assigned_to, scheduled_start)
CREATE INDEX inspections_status_idx ON public.inspections USING btree (status)
CREATE INDEX inspections_created_at_idx ON public.inspections USING btree (created_at)

CREATE INDEX inspections_no_overlap_per_inspector ON public.inspections USING gist (assigned_to, tstzrange(scheduled_start, scheduled_end, '[)'::text)) WHERE ((status <> 'canceled'::inspection_status) AND (scheduled_start IS NOT NULL) AND (scheduled_end IS NOT NULL))
CREATE INDEX inspections_metrics_idx ON public.inspections USING btree (created_at, type, status, property_city, created_by, assigned_to)
CREATE INDEX inspections_assigned_to_marketing_idx ON public.inspections USING btree (assigned_to_marketing)
CREATE INDEX inspections_unassigned_idx ON public.inspections USING btree (created_at DESC) WHERE ((assigned_to IS NULL) AND (status = 'new'::inspection_status))
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX inspection_status_events_pkey ON public.inspection_status_events USING btree (id)
CREATE INDEX inspection_status_events_metrics_idx ON public.inspection_status_events USING btree (changed_at, to_status, inspection_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX properties_pkey ON public.properties USING btree (id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX properties_code_normalized_unique ON public.properties USING btree (code_normalized)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX properties_code_normalized_idx ON public.properties USING btree (code_normalized)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX work_schedules_pkey ON public.work_schedules USING btree (person_id)

triggers.name: trg_inspections_updated_at
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER trg_inspections_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON public.inspections FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_updated_at()

triggers.name: trg_properties_updated_at
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER trg_properties_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON public.properties FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_updated_at()

constraints.name: inspection_checklist_items_completed_by_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (completed_by) REFERENCES people(id) ON DELETE SET NULL

constraints.name: inspection_checklist_items_created_by_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (created_by) REFERENCES people(id) ON DELETE SET NULL

constraints.name: inspection_checklist_items_inspection_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (inspection_id) REFERENCES inspections(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: inspections_no_overlap_per_inspector
constraints.definition: EXCLUDE USING gist (assigned_to WITH =, tstzrange(scheduled_start, scheduled_end, '[)'::text) WITH &&) WHERE (((status <> 'canceled'::inspection_status) AND (scheduled_start IS NOT NULL) AND (scheduled_end IS NOT NULL)))

constraints.name: inspections_schedule_valid
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((scheduled_start IS NULL) AND (scheduled_end IS NULL) AND (duration_minutes IS NULL)) OR ((scheduled_start IS NOT NULL) AND (scheduled_end IS NOT NULL) AND (duration_minutes IS NOT NULL) AND (duration_minutes > 0) AND (scheduled_end > scheduled_start))))

constraints.name: inspection_status_events_inspection_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (inspection_id) REFERENCES inspections(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: work_schedules_person_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (person_id) REFERENCES people(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
